- Excellent written and verbal English communication
- Reliable internet connection and backup workstation

Please email your resume and a tailored proposal directly to careers@apexhorizonpartners.example.com with the subject line 'Executive VA Application - [Code: BLUEBERRY]'. In your email body, please answer:

2. What is your available daily working schedule in EST?

evaluation_summary: Top-tier match for executive virtual assistance with explicit direct email application channel.
notes: Route A Direct Email detected: careers@apexhorizonpartners.example.com. Screening code: BLUEBERRY.
